args.body: Take CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-SCOPE-CHECK under valid ownership. Start with the existing acceptance crosswalk and operator reply packet. If they already have a runnable equivalent, execute and document it. Otherwise build and run the smallest check supported by the exact terms. Keep the operator's price approval and case-specific acceptance decisions explicit. Use fictional inputs only and preserve the separate item 4 decision.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Advance the catalogue service through its existing inbound route by making the approved scope easier for the operator to verify against an actual request. Paid acceptance depends on an eligible inquiry and the applicable operator decisions. Reassess when either is documented or attributable feedback arrives. Any public release still requires host-enforced independent review of its exact digest.
